summary: BioHarvest Sciences filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 29, 2026 news release announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program structured as a Canadian normal course issuer bid. The NCIB permits purchases of up to 5% of outstanding common shares, a maximum of 1,133,392 shares, commencing no earlier than five days after announcement and ending on the earlier of 12 months, full utilization, or company termination. Buybacks run through Nasdaq at prevailing prices under Rule 10b-18, with repurchased shares retired; no price or premium is stated. Watch execution pace, cash runway, and any TSX/TASE liquidity or regulatory constraints.
